about_the_game:
This is a multiplayer game developed by Unity. There are two types of gameplay:

The game's plot tells the story of an organization called the Asylum in 2030, which caused a large number of projects to break out of containment in a level 5 containment accident. You will play the role of a member of the re-containment team and work hard to survive.

The real-time multiplayer mode is a real-time duel based on the network protocol. The game has a built-in server list. Server owners can add lists through the "Add List" function in the game. We are equipped with a server audit team that will regularly review each list server to ensure its legality.

The game is still in the early stages of development, and the online story mode will be given priority for completion.
